title: ClientSnapshot v1
description: Everything OCS needs to know about one client of TFS Agreements that has at least one signed agreement. A snapshot is the complete current state, never a difference. Consumers must ignore properties they do not know.

client_ref.description: Opaque, permanent id of the client in TFS Agreements. Never shown to people.

client_number.description: The permanent client number. Never changes, never reused.

legal_name.description: Exactly as written on the client's agreements.

state.description: active: normal. trashed: in the 30-day Trash. purged: details wiped in TFS Agreements; signed agreements are kept.

is_test.description: Always false in the feed: test clients and test agreements are never published. Present so a consumer can assert it.

agreements.description: Every signed agreement of the client, oldest first. Signed means: an envelope completed by every signer, or a past agreement filed on the client's record with a signed date or a signed copy.

snapshot_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of this object without snapshot_hash and generated_at. Equal hash = nothing changed.

agreement_ref.description: Opaque, permanent id of this signed agreement. One per signed document.

origin.description: portal_signed: generated and signed electronically in TFS Agreements. filed_past: signed before or outside the portal and filed on the client's record.

custom_kind.description: For kind custom: the key of the agreement type.

reference.description: The agreement reference printed on the document, or the envelope reference, or the DocuSign/Jotform id of a past agreement.

key.description: Stable key of the contracting company.

legal_name.description: Exactly as on the agreement, e.g. SCRIBE ALIGN LLC.

signed_on.description: The date the last client signer signed (company time zone), or the signed date written on a past agreement. null only for a filed past agreement whose date is unknown.

terms.description: Commercial terms stated once for the agreement.

services.description: The services on a Services Agreement (or a custom agreement that carries services). Empty for BAA and NDA, and for past agreements whose services were not recorded.

documents.description: The files of this agreement. Fetch each with GET /documents/{document_ref}.

service_id.description: Stable id of the service in the TFS Agreements catalogue (e.g. medical_billing), or custom_<hash> for a service typed on this agreement.

name.description: The service's name as printed on the agreement.

details.description: Service parameters and agreed deliverables as typed.

options.description: Present when the agreement offered several fee options for this service. Option A is first.

selected_option.description: The option the client chose when signing. When set, `pricing` equals that option's pricing.

model.description: percentage | fte | pte | unit | fixed | consultancy | one_time | two_installments | rate_card | custom:<id>. Consumers must accept unknown models and fall back to summary.

summary.description: One readable line stating the price exactly as agreed, e.g. "6% of net collections". Always present; the safe fallback for any consumer.

rate.description: Decimal as a string. Percent for percentage; USD otherwise.

values.description: For a custom pricing model: the values of its fields by key.
